  • Classes in de.hof.dms.dto used by de.hof.dms.controller
    Class
    Description
    AclDto
    API-layer view of a FolderAcl: owner, owning department, the allowed user/role/department lists, the effective AccessDto flags and the inheritFromParent switch.
    AdminOverviewResponse
    Aggregated payload for the admin dashboard endpoint: the user and role catalogue, the configured permission scopes, per-component health status and high-level system counts.
    CreateFolderRequest
    Payload for POST /api/folders.
    DocumentMetadataResponse
    Full metadata view of a document returned by the document-detail endpoint.
    DocumentUploadResponse
    Response returned after a successful document upload: the new document id, its overall status and the initial ocrStatus of the text-extraction job that was queued.
    FolderPage
    A single page of folder listings.
    FolderResponse
    Full view of a folder document, returned when a folder is created.
    FolderSummary
    Compact folder view for list displays (subfolder listings, breadcrumbs): identity, name and full path.
    FolderViewResponse
    Aggregated payload for opening a folder: the folder itself, its breadcrumb trail, its immediate subfolders and the documents it contains.
    MetadataUpdateRequest
    Request payload for editing a document's descriptive metadata (title, description and document type) via the metadata-update endpoint.
    OcrJobResponse
    View of a document's OCR/text-extraction job for the admin OCR monitoring endpoint: the source document identity plus job state — ocrStatus, extractionMethod, retryCount and any ocrError.
    PermissionsResponse
    Returned by GET /api/documents/{id}/permissions.
    SearchResponse
    A single page of search hits plus the metadata the UI needs to paginate.
    UpdateFolderRequest
    Payload for PATCH /api/folders/{id} — rename and/or move.
